nodes.label: Case Detail Modal - Distribuidora Nexo Comercial S.A.P.I. de C.V.
nodes.description: UI screenshot of a case/deal detail modal dialog in the Captio application (Spanish locale). The modal displays a business case for 'Distribuidora Nexo Comercial S.A.P.I. de C.V.' categorized under 'Negocios / contrato'. It shows a status workflow pipeline with sequential states: Invitado, Nuevo, En revisión (currently selected/active, highlighted in purple), Consulta agendada, Revisión de conflicto, Cliente aceptado, Rechazado, and Cerrado. Below the status selector is a section titled 'Respuestas del cliente' (Client Responses) with two action buttons: 'Generar resumen' (Generate Summary, prominent blue button with scales icon) and 'Eliminar' (Delete, secondary button). A subsection labeled 'Información básica' (Basic Information) is visible at the bottom. The modal has a close (X) button in the top right corner. The design follows a clean, card-based modal layout with pill-shaped status tags.
design_decisions: generate summary AI feature prominently featured
nodes.purpose: Case management detail view showing client onboarding/contracting workflow status and client response data
